title: Captain's Quarters Riverfront #2
description:
Beautiful Condo Downtown Riverfront-Walking distance from Broadway where you will find the best spots in Nashville. Honky Tonk Central , LP Field, Bridgestone Arena, Restaurants, Music City Row, The Ryman, Top Golf and much more! Free parking, wifi and HDTV. Pool for relaxing or sit on the balcony & enjoy the beauty of the river. Keurig coffee maker, linens, king bed & a trundle bed in the common area. Why not join me and stay at one of the best places in downtown Nashville! (Steps to condo)

The space
Beautiful condo overlooking the river. Wonderful fireplace to snuggle next to as you look out the big open window at the boats going by. Large screened in deck with patio chairs overlooking the river. If you're looking for a romantic stay or a fun getaway close to downtown Nashville this is the place for you!
